title: The Stormlight Keeper

delivery.audio: Original 24-second atmospheric score and storm ambience; no narration.

creativeDirection.objective: Tell a wordless miniature rescue story: a small maintenance robot restores a lighthouse beacon during a violent storm.
creativeDirection.concept: A tiny brass-and-ceramic robot crosses a storm-lashed headland, repairs the lighthouse mechanism, and sends a sweeping beam back across the dark sea.

visualSystem.composition: Painterly 2.5D layered compositions with strong silhouettes, deep foreground framing and dramatic horizon lines.
visualSystem.lighting: Cold blue lightning and moonlit rim light; practical amber work lamp; final warm beacon volumetrics.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Weathered stone, wet iron, aged brass, chipped cream enamel, salt spray and rough ocean foam.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Wind-driven rain and sea spray, robot footfalls and arm articulation, pulsing work lamp, spinning optics, mechanical repair action, lighthouse beam sweep and deliberate camera trucking/dolly moves.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Original low-string atmospheric score, storm wind, surf, spaced thunder and delicate metal repair accents. No narration.
assumptions: The robot and lighthouse are fictional original designs.
The entire story is told visually; no text and no spoken dialogue.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: Original procedural/vector/3D assets and original synthesized sound only.

shots.purpose: Establish the dangerous coastline and reveal the small scale of the robot.
shots.visual: A sweeping ultra-wide coastal view: a battered lighthouse stands on a jagged headland above slate-blue waves; a tiny robot trudges into frame through rain.
shots.framing: Extreme wide aerial at a high oblique angle; lighthouse on the right third, robot a small warm point in lower-left foreground.
shots.cameraMovement: Descending crane and slow lateral drift toward the cliff.
shots.audio: Wind and distant surf swell under a low original score.
shots.action: Waves surge and break against rocks while the robot climbs the slick path toward the lighthouse.
shots.visualProgression: Start: near-black storm and lightning silhouette. Development: coast and tower emerge; robot advances. End: camera aligns toward the tower door.

shots.purpose: Make the robot's scale and mission tangible.
shots.visual: Low close tracking shot at the lighthouse base as the robot reaches a warped iron door; its amber lamp glints across rain-beaded rivets.
shots.framing: Low medium close-up, robot foreground left, immense curved stone wall rising behind.
shots.cameraMovement: Ground-level tracking push that tilts up with the robot looking toward the dark lantern room.
shots.transition: Match cut from the tower silhouette to the door's circular rivet.
shots.audio: Small metallic footsteps, rain on iron, one heavy thunder roll.
shots.action: Robot braces against repeated gusts, shifts stance, reaches for the handle and forces the heavy door open; warm light spills into the rain.
shots.visualProgression: Start: robot and door already move in the gusts. Development: robot reaches and the door swings open. End: robot slips inside, amber lamp visible.

shots.purpose: Reveal the broken beacon mechanism and raise the stakes.
shots.visual: Inside a dark spiral stairwell, the robot climbs past wet stone and broken steps; camera looks down through the central void as it reaches the shattered lantern mechanism.
shots.framing: Top-down vertical composition with circular stair geometry and robot moving diagonally through frame.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow rotating overhead descent following the spiral.
shots.transition: Doorway darkness becomes the stairwell's central void.
shots.audio: Interior rain-muted wind, rhythmic gear ticks, footfalls on iron steps.
shots.action: Robot climbs, reaches the lantern room and discovers a snapped drive belt and a dark Fresnel lens.
shots.visualProgression: Start: descending view into a deep spiral. Development: robot climbs into the lantern chamber. End: broken gears fill the frame.

shots.purpose: Show a specific, legible repair rather than a generic action pose.
shots.visual: Extreme macro of the robot's articulated hands: it aligns a replacement brass coupling, threads a pin through the drive assembly and tightens it as lightning flashes through rain-streaked glass.
shots.framing: Macro diagonal crop with coupling and claws dominating; shallow depth of field, lightning-window bokeh behind.
shots.cameraMovement: Precise lateral slider with a tiny rack-focus from claw tip to locking pin.
shots.transition: Hard cut on first metal contact.
shots.audio: Metal click, tiny ratchet sequence, thunder crack; score builds.
shots.action: The robot inserts the coupling, locks the pin and turns the gear by hand; the lens begins to rotate.
shots.visualProgression: Start: broken coupling visibly separated. Development: pin slides into aligned holes and locks. End: gears engage and lens starts turning, catching the first amber glint.

shots.purpose: Deliver the visual transformation and emotional payoff.
shots.visual: From inside the lantern room, the Fresnel lens catches fire with warm light; its rotating beam slices through rain and fog as the robot shields its optics.
shots.framing: Wide interior hero shot with lens dominating the center, robot silhouette in right foreground, glass panes and storm beyond.
shots.cameraMovement: Dolly orbit around lens as the beam completes its first sweep.
shots.transition: The amber glint from the macro match-cuts into the illuminated lens.
shots.audio: Mechanical spin-up, rising tonal swell, beacon ignition chime and storm still raging.
shots.action: The lens accelerates from a stutter to a steady rotation; the beam sweeps across the storm.
shots.visualProgression: Start: lens dark and still. Development: filament ignites and light refracts through glass prisms. End: beam completes a full sweep into the night.

shots.purpose: Show the repair's consequence and end on a memorable image.
shots.visual: Exterior dawn-blue wide shot from out over the water: the lighthouse beam sweeps across the churning sea, revealing a small fishing vessel turning toward the safe harbor; the robot is visible as a tiny silhouette in the lantern room.
shots.framing: Very wide water-level composition with beam diagonal across frame; tower on far right and ship centered low.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow pullback over waves as the beam passes camera and fades into mist.
shots.transition: Match cut from the rotating lens beam to its exterior sweep.
shots.audio: Storm softens slightly; score resolves with warm strings and lingering surf.
shots.action: The beam rotates over the water and briefly illuminates the vessel as it turns toward harbor.
shots.visualProgression: Start: dark sea with beam just entering. Development: vessel appears under the sweep and changes course. End: lighthouse beacon holds steady while camera retreats.

acceptanceCriteria: A new registered LighthouseRepairFilm composition is used and is not a modified prior composition.
The robot has a consistent, readable silhouette and visible articulated repair action.
The six shots differ in scale, camera placement and visual event; the sequence tells a complete wordless story.
Rain, surf, fog, lightning and lighthouse illumination create a coherent storm atmosphere without obscuring the subject.
The beacon visibly transitions from dark/broken to rotating and illuminating the sea.
No text, captions, logos or dialogue appear.

renderStrategy.rationale: A dedicated custom Remotion composition using GPU-independent SVG vector rendering guarantees deterministic headless output on GitHub-hosted runners without WebGL/GPU support. The six-shot artwork uses layered SVG paths/shapes and animated transforms, with original robot, lighthouse, storm, mechanism, Fresnel and vessel designs.
requiredCapabilities: Vector lighthouse, storm coastline, articulated maintenance robot, spiral stairwell, repair mechanism, rotating Fresnel lens and distant vessel
Six distinct scene framings with continuous character, water, rain, gear and beacon motion
Animated camera-style pan/zoom, atmospheric lightning and warm/cool cinematic lighting
Original synthesized score and storm ambience
renderStrategy.fallback: The main renderer is SVG/Remotion and requires no GPU.
